theorems.name: Submission.ind_ab_weighted_ball_growth
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (x : Eucl P) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Eucl P)), NullMeasurableSet M (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) → (∀ y ∈ M, 0 ≤ θ y) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → IntegrableOn θ (M ∩ K) (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P))) → HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ x Q → ∃ C : ℝ≥0, ∀ᶠ s in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), ∫⁻ y in M ∩ closedBall x s, ENNReal.ofReal (θ y) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) ≤ C * ENNReal.ofReal (s ^ n)
